newsitem.title: UK: UK to give 8,000 tonnes beef to poor and homeless.
newsitem.headline: UK to give 8,000 tonnes beef to poor and homeless.

text.p: The government said on Tuesday it would distribute up to 8,000 tonnes of surplus beef next year to Britain's poor and homeless.
The government ran a similar surplus food scheme in 1995.

All the beef, which will be offal-free and come from animals less than 30 months' old, that are least at risk of BSE, will have been bought into intervention since April 1996, junior agriculture minister Tony Baldry said in a written parliamentary answer.
